stem: In each section of this question choose the answer or answers from the options listed.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Identify **two** particles produced during the reaction of methane and chlorine in the presence of UV light.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the **two** particles produced by the heterolytic fission of a bond in chloromethane.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Seven reaction types are listed.

addition   substitution   oxidation   elimination

hydrolysis   condensation   reduction
parts.text: Name the type of reaction involved when Tollens' reagent is used to identify an aldehyde.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction involved in the test for a carbonyl group using 2,4-DNPH.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction involved in the reaction of a ketone with $\text{NaBH}_4$.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction involved in the reaction of an aldehyde with $\text{HCN}$.
